supportingText: Start with a calm Goal Mapping conversation; youth complete it immediately before one structured first class.
goalMappingClothing: Youth: clean athletic clothing; adults: lane-specific preparation guidance

steps.title: Reserve Your Free Intro
steps.subtitle: Goal Mapping before class
steps.description: Request your visit online. Pick your preferred student lane (Kids, Teens, Adults) and general schedule preferences.

steps.title: Meet Sandy for Goal Mapping
steps.subtitle: One-visit starting plan
steps.description: Tour the mats, review safety, discuss goals, and set the starting plan. For youth, Goal Mapping happens immediately before one structured class during the same visit.

steps.title: Train in the right starting lane
steps.subtitle: Matched, coached first class
steps.description: Youth plan for 60–75 minutes and arrive 20 minutes before class in clean athletic clothing. Adults receive lane-specific scheduling guidance.

steps.title: Attend Your First Class Free
steps.subtitle: Coached Learning Experience
steps.description: Step onto the mat for a calm, guided introduction to Jiu-Jitsu with zero obligation to enroll.
